_doc: clinic-rival-race — act one of the demo, asserted rather than narrated.
The page's rival is a seeded simulation, labelled as one on screen. This case proves the race
is real: a slot the visitor was looking at is taken by someone else while they read, the board
says who took it, and the page never pretends the slot is still available. It also proves the
honest counterpart — an agent that tries to hold a slot the rival already took is refused with

eval: (() => { const n = document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot-state="open"]').length; window.__open0 = n; return n >= 2; })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-slot-state="taken_by_rival"]'); window.__gone = el && el.getAttribute('data-clinic-slot'); return typeof window.__gone; })()
